title: Weight Loss Basics
summary: Sustainable weight loss comes from a modest calorie deficit through balanced eating, more movement, enough protein, sleep and consistency. Crash diets usually rebound; spot reduction (losing fat from one area) isn't possible.
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
